name: Zoom: call with no recording
description: Zoom decides whether a booked call happened; the recording is only what was said. When Zoom shows the prospect on the call for 5 minutes or more and no recording has reached the booking 2 hours after the meeting ended, the team is told in the alerts channel, so a call is never taken for a no-show because the notetaker missed it. A call Zoom shows nobody joined is left alone. The client hears nothing.

nodes.title: No recording on the booking yet
Wait up to 2 hours for the recording
Still no recording on the booking
Tell the team: the call happened and nothing recorded it
nodes.template:

Zoom shows them on the call for {{event.prospect_minutes}} minutes, and no recording reached the booking 2 hours after it ended. It is not a no-show. Check the notetaker was let in, and file the outcome by hand.
